description: The ControlFilter.java file is a Java source file implementing a servlet filter used within the OFBiz framework to control access to certain URL paths. It handles request filtering based on allowed paths, redirection, and security checks, specifically to enforce an allowlist of URL patterns and prevent malicious URL usage.

classes.name: ControlFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter class responsible for enforcing an allowlist of URL paths, redirecting or blocking requests based on configuration and security rules within the OFBiz web application.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration parameters such as redirect path, error code, allowed paths, and whether to force redirect all traffic.

methods.name: readErrorCode
methods.description: Converts a string parameter to an integer error code, defaulting if parsing fails.

methods.name: readAllowedPaths
methods.description: Splits a colon-separated string of allowed paths into a set of individual path strings.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Sends an HTTP redirect response to the client, based on whether the redirect path is a URL or a relative path.

methods.name: getAllowedTokens
methods.description: Loads a list of allowed tokens from the security properties for URL validation.

methods.name: isControlFilterTests
methods.description: Checks if the system property for testing is set to enable special test behavior.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Main filtering logic that checks request URIs against allowed paths, enforces security checks, handles redirection, and blocks insecure or malformed URLs.
